description: Compute a free Purchasing Readiness Score (0-100) and gap list for a codebase without generating artifacts. No auth, no charge, no snapshot persisted. Hard caps: 25 files / 50KB per file / 1MB total. Returns score, risk_level, top gaps, frameworks detected, and which AXIS programs would close which gaps. Use this to triage 'should I pay for the full hardening bundle?' before calling prepare_agentic_purchasing. The paid version generates the full artifact bundle including CE 3.0 dispute evidence, SCA exemption matrix, and TAP interop.
